title: 2026년 11월 5일, 인공지능 분야에서 무슨 일이 일어났을까요?
intro: Agent builders are replacing blocking loops with async execution, explicit state machines and retry-safe tool calls.
Kimi K3.1 Pro weights shipped with day-zero Ascend support, while SemiAnalysis's GDPx shows the best model solving only 12% of long agent tasks.
highlights: LangChain: agents must keep working in the background yet stay responsive.
Call4Agents guarantees approved tool calls run at most once after a crash.
GDPx agent benchmark: best model scores 12%; cost per point compared for 12 models.
Moonshot releases Kimi K3.1 Pro weights and launches Kimi Hosted Agents.
OpenAI debuts GPT-6 Cyber for vulnerability discovery and fixes.
Google TPUs now serve Oracle, OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta, per SemiAnalysis.
